description: Generate a full spike decision document for a technical choice, grounded in the repo's real stack and live registry facts (versions, downloads, licenses). Requires the user to have run `spikeme login` in a terminal and to have an active plan.

options.description: How many options to compare (2-4, default 3)

topic.description: The technical decision to spike, e.g. "state management library" or "asyncpg vs psycopg".

name: generate_spike
title: Generate spike
